intent: A segmented control in which the selection is one raised pill that travels between segments on a spring. The pill sits beneath every label, so labels never blank out as it passes. Segments can carry icons and counts, sit at equal or content widths, and at content width scroll sideways behind soft edges when the track runs out of room. Monochrome and dark first, with no accent colour.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS variables set on the root from a theme prop, and @container on the root
stack.animation: motion/react: one pill element measured from the selected segment and moved on spring.ui (stiffness 500, damping 40); animate for the demo count tween and the demo column width; useInView and useReducedMotion for the demo entrance

layout.track: radiogroup with 3px inner padding. Equal width: flex row filling the root, each segment flex 1 1 0 with min-width 0. Content width: fit-content, max-width 100%, scrolls horizontally when overflowing.
layout.pill: one absolutely positioned element inside the track's content, beneath the segments, placed at the selected segment's offsetLeft and offsetWidth
layout.segments: 36px tall (md) or 30px (sm). Horizontal padding 10px, 14px from a 22rem container. Icon and label gap 6px (md) or 5px (sm).
layout.overflow: content width only: scrollbar hidden, 28px fades at each edge shown only while more content lies past that edge, the selected segment scrolled to at least 32px inside any faded edge (smooth, instant under reduced motion), and kept in view while the box resizes
layout.demo: 440px card on a theme-following stage filling the frame with min-h-dvh, with a mono header (Dictation volume, the selected period and a tweening count), one equal-width control (Week, Month, Year with icons and counts) and a hairline with a mono Narrow column toggle; pressing the toggle narrows the control's column to 232px and switches it to content width so it overflows

typography.label: Geist 500, tracking -0.01em, 14px (md) or 13px (sm), nowrap
typography.count: Geist 400, tabular figures, 13px (md) or 12px (sm), muted ink, Intl.NumberFormat en-US

color.approach: CSS variables on the root from the theme prop. Dark: track #19191c, pill #2c2c31, ink #f4f4f5, muted #8a8a93, hover lift 4% white, track ring 1px inset at 7% white. Light: track #f1f1f3, pill #ffffff, ink #18181b, muted #64646e, hover lift 4% ink, track ring 1px inset at 7% ink.
color.pill: dark: 1px inset hairline at 8% white, 1px inset top highlight, 1px 2px drop at 50% black, soft 6px 14px drop at 70% black; light: 5% ink hairline, white top highlight, 10% drop, 28% soft drop
color.states: selected label ink; unselected label muted, moving to ink on hover with a 4% surface lift (enabled only); disabled at 40% opacity with cursor-not-allowed and no hover
color.accent: none. Monochrome by design: the selection is ink on paper.

motion.pill: one element beneath every label, measured from the selected segment and moved on spring.ui (stiffness 500, damping 40). Reversed picks redirect mid-flight. Not a layoutId.
motion.colour: unselected hover: label colour and a 4% surface lift over 150ms ease-out, curve 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1
motion.press: the label of an enabled segment scales to 0.97 over 90ms on the same curve and springs back on release; the segment itself is not transformed
motion.edges: scroll fades fade in and out over 200ms ease-out
motion.scroll: selected segment scrolled into view, clear of any faded edge, with a smooth scroll when the selection moves and an instant scroll while the box resizes
motion.demo: card rises 12px out of an 8px blur over 500ms ease-out; header at 60ms, control at 160ms, column toggle at 260ms; header count tweens from 0 over 500ms and tallies on each change; column narrows 100% to 232px over 420ms on cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)
motion.reducedMotion: pill jumps, scroll jumps, column narrows at once, entrance is a 150ms opacity fade; colour transitions stay

responsive.equal: works from 320px upward; longer labels truncate with an ellipsis instead of breaking the row
responsive.content: scrolls inside its own box; the page never scrolls sideways
responsive.demo: card max-width 440px, 24px stage padding and 40px from sm; the demo column narrows to 232px so the overflow mode shows at every width

accessibility: track role=radiogroup with aria-label; each segment a native button with role=radio and aria-checked
roving tabIndex: selected segment 0, the others -1
ArrowRight and ArrowDown select and focus the next enabled segment; ArrowLeft and ArrowUp the previous; both wrap like native radios
Home and End select the first and last enabled segments; disabled segments are skipped
Space and Enter activate through the native button
focus-visible: 2px ink outline drawn 3px inside the segment so it stays visible over the pill and inside the scrolling track; instant and keyboard only
icons aria-hidden; counts are plain text read after the label
picking the already selected segment fires no change
demo column toggle is a button with aria-pressed and a 2px focus outline offset 2px

content.options: Day, Week, Month, Quarter, Year, All time, each with an icon and a count (3, 17, 64, 188, 741, 2314)
content.segments: 2 shows Week and Year; 3 adds Month; 4 adds Day; 5 adds Quarter; 6 adds All time
demoSteps: click Week (the pill travels left from Month)
click Year (the pill travels right over Month, its labels stay readable)
click Week (the pill travels back left over Month)
press Narrow column (the column narrows to 232px, the control switches to content width and the track shows Week with Year behind the end fade)
click Week to focus it, then press Arrow Right twice: Month, then Year, with the track scrolling to bring Year into view clear of the end fade

avoid: an accent colour, glow, gradient track or gradient text
bounce past the spring, pulsing selection, or animation longer than 800ms
sparkle or AI icons, emoji, or pill badges on the counts
a separate selected label or checkmark; the pill is the status
a hard cut between segments, or a pill that paints over a label; reduced motion removes only the travel
a layoutId pill, or a press scale on the segment that stacks the pill inside a transformed box
a visible scrollbar in the overflow track, or an edge fade on a track that is not overflowing
an edge fade that covers the selected segment or its focus ring
a disabled segment in the demo (disabled is supported, not demonstrated)
hover-only affordances; every segment works by keyboard and touch
